name: InTac F1
summary: A curved optical tactile fingertip for dexterous hands, with replaceable silicone contact material and output of tactile images, contact point clouds and contact-force vectors.

description.en: A curved optical tactile fingertip for dexterous hands, with replaceable silicone contact material and output of tactile images, contact point clouds and contact-force vectors.
